questionEnglish: Which of the following metals is a liquid at room temperature?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଧାତୁ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ତରଳ ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ଥାଏ?
explanation: Mercury (Hg) is the only metal that remains in a liquid state at standard room temperature.

questionEnglish: Which property allows metals to be drawn into thin wires?
questionOdia: ଧାତୁଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସରୁ ତାରରେ ପରିଣତ କରିବାର ଗୁଣକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Ductility is the physical property of a material that allows it to be stretched into thin wires without breaking.

questionEnglish: Which of the following non-metals is a good conductor of electricity?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ଅଧାତୁଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ବିଦ୍ୟୁତର ସୁପରିବାହୀ?
explanation: Graphite is an allotrope of carbon that has free electrons, allowing it to conduct electricity, unlike most other non-metals.

questionEnglish: Which metal can be easily cut with a knife?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ଧାତୁକୁ ଛୁରୀ ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ସହଜରେ କଟାଯାଇପାରିବ?
explanation: Sodium and Potassium are alkali metals that are exceptionally soft and can be sliced easily with a common knife.

questionEnglish: An alloy of mercury with another metal is called?
questionOdia: ପାରଦ ସହିତ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ଧାତୁର ମିଶ୍ରଧାତୁକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: An amalgam is a specific type of alloy formed by combining mercury with one or more other metals.

questionEnglish: What are oxides that react with both acids and bases called?
questionOdia: ଯେଉଁ ଅକ୍ସାଇଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଉଭୟ ଅମ୍ଳ ଏବଂ କ୍ଷାରକ ସହିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରନ୍ତି, ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Oxides that show both acidic and basic behaviors, like Aluminum oxide (Al2O3), are known as amphoteric oxides.

questionEnglish: Which of the following metals does not react even with water or steam?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଧାତୁ ଜଳ କିମ୍ବା ଜଳୀୟ ବାଷ୍ପ ସହିତ ଆଦୌ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରେ ନାହିଁ?
explanation: Gold (Au) and Silver (Ag) are highly unreactive noble metals at the bottom of the reactivity series and do not react with water in any form.

questionEnglish: Aqua regia is a freshly prepared mixture of concentrated HCl and concentrated HNO3 in what ratio?
questionOdia: ଆକ୍ଵା ରେଜିଆ (Aqua regia) ହେଉଛି ଗାଢ HCl ଏବଂ ଗାଢ HNO3 ର ଏକ ମିଶ୍ରଣ, ଏହାର ଅନୁପାତ କେତେ?
explanation: Aqua Regia is a highly corrosive mixture made by combining concentrated Hydrochloric acid and concentrated Nitric acid in a 3:1 ratio.

questionEnglish: Which non-metal is lustrous in nature?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଅଧାତୁଟି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ବା ଚମକଦାର?
explanation: While most non-metals are dull, Iodine is an exception as it displays a distinct metallic-like lustrous shine.

questionEnglish: Which chemical process is used to extract highly reactive metals like Sodium?
questionOdia: ସୋଡିୟମ୍ ଭଳି ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାଶୀଳ ଧାତୁର ନିଷ୍କାସନ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ରାସାୟନିକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ?
explanation: Highly reactive metals bind strongly to oxygen and cannot be reduced by carbon, so they are extracted via electrolytic reduction of their molten chlorides.
